The SAVE America Act is designed to ensure that every eligible U.S. citizen can vote. @ChipTWyatt of @Heritage_Action explains that the legislation provides multiple ways to verify citizenship, from birth certificates and passports to alternative processes for voters who may not have traditional documentation readily available. The focus is on protecting election integrity while ensuring legitimate voters aren't left behind.

🎙️ Listen to the full episode wherever you listen to podcasts, or here
